title: Publishers paying to place songs and style demos
summary: Publishers paid $1,000 to $4,000 for Clanton to record their songs, and sent demos imitating the artist's style, such as those by Doc Pomus.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life
